text:
Alex R: Quick async — status and asks
Alex R: Ran the KMS dry-run against staging this morning. Found 3 keys past their rotation window (stg-data-key-1/2/3). Opened PR #542 to add rotation jobs + update key aliases. Need a quick review because this touches the data pipeline. Also saw an IAM role with a broad resource wildcard on service-account 'pipeline-runner' — not sure if that was intentional. CC @Maria G @Kevin S
Maria G: Thanks Alex — on it. The wildcard for pipeline-runner looks like a leftover from the old deploy script. Recommend scoping to resources: arn:aws:s3:::redwood-data/* and s3:GetObject only. Can you paste the policy snippet?
Alex R: Here is the snippet I found:
```json
"Action": "s3:*",
"Resource": "*"
```
Alex R: I'll change it to the s3:GetObject + specific bucket ARN in the PR, but wanted to flag before merging.
Kevin S: Good catch. If PR touches keys that back the prod pipeline, let's schedule a hotfix deploy during the 4pm deploy window — unless Jen can vouch it's safe to roll earlier. Also I started the IAM cleanup ticket; assigned 3 business owners to attest access by EOD Friday.
Jen L: I can do the PR review tomorrow morning (9:30am PT). If Maria has suggested exact policy lines, I can push the change and run the rotation dry-run in staging.
Alex R: One blocker: when I try to run the rotation job in staging I'm getting a 403 on the key-rotate service — seems like my role lacks kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion or kms:UpdateKeyDescription perms.
ops-bot: Access request logged — ticket INFRA-1892 created for Alex R access to key-rotate (approver: infra-admins).
Maria G: I can approve once you paste the exact API call you're making. If it's using the rotation wrapper, we might need kms:PutKeyPolicy too.
sec-bot: Vulnerability scan result (2026-03-17): discovered outdated client in pipeline-runner image (glibc CVE-2025-9999) — severity: medium. Tracking in VULN-204.
Kevin S: Noted. Can we get a rebuild of the pipeline-runner base image and a canary test? If vuln is medium, aim to fix this week.
Alex R: Action items for me: 1) update PR #542 with scoped policy, 2) request perms via INFRA-1892, 3) coordinate with Jen for rotation dry-run after access, 4) requeue pipeline-runner base image rebuild.
Maria G: Action items for me: review PR + policy, approve INFRA-1892 if API call looks correct, and help with canary once base image rebuilt.
Jen L: I'll review PR tomorrow and schedule the staging canary for pipeline-runner after the rebuild.
Kevin S: I'll follow up on VULN-204 and set target to resolve by Friday. Ping me if the rotation touches prod keys so I can approve emergency window.
Alex R: Thanks all — will update this thread as I make progress. :thumbsup:
